data.narrative:
Aeon Industrial is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $18.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public firms operating in the same sector, including peers at Seed and Series A stages such as UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $46M. Peer-Median analysis across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comps produces a $400M midpoint, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. The significant spread reflects heterogeneity within the defense-tech market at early stages.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $40M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $223M. The wide dispersion between methods—driven primarily by the peer-median approach anchoring to $400M versus the more conservative stage-progression result—underscores material uncertainty around comparable company selection and appropriate market multiples for Seed-stage defense firms. Capital efficiency metrics, technical differentiation within the defense-security space, and customer traction would be critical factors for narrowing this range.
